hooks.command:
P=/usr/local; [ -w /usr/local ] || P=$HOME/.local
M=
V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\).*/\1/')
if [ "${V:-0}" -lt 18 ]; then
  case $(uname -m) in x86_64) A=x64;; aarch64|arm64) A=arm64;; *) A=;; esac
  U=https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v22.x
  [ -n "$A" ] && L=$(curl -fsSL $U/ 2>/dev/null || wget -qO- $U/ 2>/dev/null)
  T=$(printf %s "$L" | grep -o "node-v[0-9.]*-linux-$A\.tar\.gz" | head -1)
  if [ -n "$T" ] && mkdir -p "$P/lib/nodejs" "$P/bin"; then
    (curl -fsSL "$U/$T" 2>/dev/null || wget -qO- "$U/$T" 2>/dev/null) | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "$P/lib/nodejs" && { for b in node npm npx; do ln -sf "$P/lib/nodejs/bin/$b" "$P/bin/$b"; done; M=" node $T"; }
  fi
fi
PATH="$P/bin:$PATH"; hash -r
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ]; then
  npm i -g bun >/dev/null 2>&1
  B=$(npm prefix -g)/bin/bun
  [ -x "$B" ] && { [ "$B" = "$P/bin/bun" ] || ln -sf "$B" "$P/bin/bun"; M="$M bun $("$B" -v 2>/dev/null)"; }
fi
[ -n "$M" ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"Installed%s to %s (needed by claude-mem and ponytail hooks)"}' "$M" "$P"
exit 0
